endpoint_condition: Measured exactly as the board's three other GLiNER rows were: Sandy's CPU at 4 threads, the unchanged GLiNER2 mapping from jevbench/adapters/gliner2_local.py, native single-label softmax read out in full. Its latency on the items it did answer matches its sibling GLiNER2 large closely (median 1.11 s / p95 13.66 s here against that row's published 1.10 s / 14.49 s), so the measurement is sound where it ran. What stopped it is the long hard-tier documents, on a host whose load average rose from 8 to 20 on 12 cores during the run because of unrelated jobs — receipts/SANDY-LOAD-DURING-GLINER.txt.
not_ranked_because: The system does not return on the hard tier's long-document items within 120 s, the same per-request timeout JevBench's typesafe adapter gives every HTTP-served system. It answered the whole easy tier, the whole standard tier and 144 of 146 judge items, then one of the first four hard items exceeded the bound and the run was stopped by the evaluator rather than left to spend hours producing a latency number measured under heavy unrelated load. 524 of 842 decisions were never attempted, including all 308 sealed items, so there is no score. Re-measure on an idle machine before ranking.
